#!/usr/bin/env node
// Generated by Pluffy from @arkzen:pkg:template. Copies the template folder into a new project and fills in {{variables}}.
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import readline from 'node:readline'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

const HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))
const TEMPLATE = path.join(HERE, '..', 'template')
const VARIABLES = __VARIABLES__
const IGNORE = __IGNORE__
const HINTS = __HINTS__
// npm never packs files called .gitignore or .npmignore, so the template stores them with an underscore.
const RENAME = { _gitignore: '.gitignore', _npmignore: '.npmignore' }

const args = process.argv.slice(2)
const flags = {}
const positional = []
for (const arg of args) {
  const m = arg.match(/^--([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)(?:=(.*))?$/)
  if (m) flags[m[1]] = m[2] === undefined ? true : m[2]
  else if (arg === '-y') flags.yes = true
  else positional.push(arg)
}
if (flags.help || flags.h) {
  console.log('Usage: [directory] [--yes] [--force]' + VARIABLES.map(v => ' [--' + v.name + '=<value>]').join(''))
  process.exit(0)
}

const target = path.resolve(positional[0] ?? '.')
const interactive = Boolean(process.stdin.isTTY) && !flags.yes
const rl = interactive ? readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout }) : null
const ask = question => new Promise(resolve => rl.question(question, resolve))

const values = {}
for (const variable of VARIABLES) {
  const fallback = variable.default ?? (variable.name === 'name' ? path.basename(target) : '')
  if (typeof flags[variable.name] === 'string') values[variable.name] = flags[variable.name]
  else if (interactive) values[variable.name] = (await ask((variable.prompt ?? variable.name) + (fallback ? ' (' + fallback + ')' : '') + ': ')).trim() || fallback
  else values[variable.name] = fallback
}
if (rl) rl.close()

if (fs.existsSync(target) && fs.readdirSync(target).length > 0 && !flags.force) {
  console.error('The directory ' + target + ' is not empty. Choose another directory or pass --force.')
  process.exit(1)
}

// "*" matches inside one folder, "**" across folders. Anything else is literal.
function globToRegExp(pattern) {
  let out = ''
  for (let i = 0; i < pattern.length; i++) {
    const c = pattern[i]
    if (c === '*' && pattern[i + 1] === '*') { out += '.*'; i++ }
    else if (c === '*') out += '[^/]*'
    else out += c.replace(/[.+^${}()|[\]\\?]/g, '\\$&')
  }
  return new RegExp('^' + out + '$')
}
const ignoreRules = IGNORE.map(p => globToRegExp(p.includes('/') || p.includes('*') ? p : '**/' + p))
const ignored = rel => ignoreRules.some(re => re.test(rel)) || ignoreRules.some(re => re.test(rel.split('/').pop()))
const isBinary = buffer => buffer.subarray(0, 8000).includes(0)
const fill = text => text.replace(/\{\{\s*([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\s*\}\}/g, (all, key) => (key in values ? values[key] : all))

let count = 0
function walk(from, rel) {
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(from, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const relPath = rel ? rel + '/' + entry.name : entry.name
    if (ignored(relPath)) continue
    const outName = RENAME[entry.name] ?? entry.name
    const outPath = path.join(target, rel, fill(outName))
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      fs.mkdirSync(outPath, { recursive: true })
      walk(path.join(from, entry.name), relPath)
    } else {
      const buffer = fs.readFileSync(path.join(from, entry.name))
      fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outPath), { recursive: true })
      fs.writeFileSync(outPath, isBinary(buffer) ? buffer : fill(buffer.toString('utf8')))
      count++
    }
  }
}
fs.mkdirSync(target, { recursive: true })
walk(TEMPLATE, '')
console.log('Created ' + count + ' file(s) in ' + target)
if (HINTS.length) console.log('\nNext steps:\n' + HINTS.map(h => '  ' + h).join('\n'))
